question: According to the NITI Aayog's discussion paper released in January 2024, which state recorded the highest number of people escaping multidimensional poverty between 2013-14 and 2022-23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the NITI Aayog's discussion paper released in January 2024, **Uttar Pradesh recorded the highest number of people escaping multidimensional poverty** between 2013-14 and 2022-23.
 
• Multidimensional poverty refers to deprivation across multiple indicators such as health, education, and living standards, rather than income alone.
 
• Uttar Pradesh's achievement is attributed to focused efforts on improving access to basic amenities, health facilities, and education.
 
• Government initiatives like the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana, Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, and rural electrification have played a significant role in poverty reduction.
 
• NITI Aayog uses the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), aligned with global standards, to assess poverty reduction in states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NITI Aayog's Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI):**

 
 
• The MPI measures poverty using three dimensions: health, education, and standard of living.
 
• It incorporates 12 indicators, including nutrition, child mortality, years of schooling, cooking fuel, sanitation, drinking water, electricity, housing, and assets.
 
• The index is aligned with the United Nations Development Programme's (UNDP) global MPI framework.
 
 
 
• **Key Government Initiatives for Poverty Reduction:**
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY):** Aims to provide affordable housing to the urban and rural poor by 2022.
 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan:** Focused on improving sanitation infrastructure and eliminating open defecation.
 
• **Saubhagya Yojana:** Ensures last-mile connectivity of electricity to all households in the country.
 
• **Ayushman Bharat:** Provides free health coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
 
 
 
• **State-Specific Achievements:**
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh has made significant strides in improving maternal and child health indicators.
 
• The state has focused on skill development programs to enhance employability and reduce income poverty.
 
 
 
• **Global Context of Multidimensional Poverty:**
 
 
• The concept was introduced by the UNDP and Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI).
 
• It emphasizes that poverty is not only about income but also encompasses deprivation in essential capabilities and access to basic services.
